verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs show agents reacting to events: an automated PR check flow (read diff, scan, post a review comment on failure), PR check runs that can be banned, mention-gated comment triggers, and triggering agents from CI/CD when builds fail. There is no documented user-facing rules engine for defining event-to-action rules, and the CI/CD trigger appears to rely on calling the API from the user's pipeline. missing for 10: a documented user-defined event→action rule configuration, a catalog of supported trigger events, native (not API-driven) event subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
